page.notes: The top margin has a partly cut-off running title (apparently "INDEX"), which is too faint to read with certainty, so it is left out. The initials R and S are large decorative letters, joined to the following word as "RHodus" and "SAmi". The "Atheniensibus" and "Syracusæ" forms are read from long s and ligature æ. The dark marks at the left edge are show-through or the edge of the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.
